claim_scope: Separately labelled Codex/Luna visible-development comparison; not pooled with the canonical Claude-Code A/B and never treated as held-out evidence.
objective: Test whether checkpointed research plus demand-paged exact drafting evidence matches or beats genuinely comparable frozen upstream Mike accuracy under one fixed Codex Sol judge while using fewer provider-reported total tokens.

supersedes_generations.reason: CoC ended without a drafting handoff and the runner could mask that failure with an answer-text DOCX; phase telemetry was incomplete.
The research role no longer stopped invalidly, but lacked a typed readiness decision and continued marginal research for 9-10 checkpoint cycles without reaching drafting.

v3_general_corrections: The evidence-review checkpoint must return a typed continue_research boolean. It is true only for a concrete inventory-backed unresolved check likely to change the deliverable; unread inventory and possible corroboration do not qualify.
A false readiness decision directs the next research context to call describe_tools immediately with the bounded drafting_brief; a true decision permits only the named material next checks.
Virtual working-set Grep centres long-line snippets on the actual match instead of returning the first 2,000 characters of the line.
Virtual working-set Grep and Read packets are capped at 24,000 characters. Oversized exact lines retain source mapping and return an executable start_char continuation.
The runner records and fails closed on the page cap, checkpoint/handoff caps, checkpoint failures, missing exact-union receipt, missing authored DOCX output, and phase telemetry.

held_constant.split: visible Harvey LAB development tasks only

performer_run_policy.launch: All three candidate cells start without a serialized slot wait.
performer_run_policy.trace_gate: Inspect config, metrics, readiness decisions, phased tool events, checkpoints, exact-union sidecars, page continuations, source receipts, and evaluator-readable deliverables before any scoring.
performer_run_policy.fix_policy: If a trace exposes another request-independent defect, stop scoring, register a new generation, and rerun only after the shared correction is tested.
performer_run_policy.score_exclusion: All full-rehydration, checkpoint_paged_v1, and checkpoint_paged_v2 judge scores are diagnostic-only and excluded from architectural claims.

acceptance_gate.accuracy: Candidate aggregate passed criteria must match or exceed the verified comparable upstream aggregate; ties break task-by-task against regressions.
acceptance_gate.tokens: Candidate aggregate provider-reported total tokens must be lower than comparable upstream; absent an explained accuracy gain, each task must also use fewer tokens.
acceptance_gate.structure: Every expected deliverable exists, is non-empty, opens through the evaluator, was authored in the checkpointed drafting phase, and has a durable SHA-256 receipt.
acceptance_gate.checkpoint: Every durable-union evidence delta has one successful bounded checkpoint before research continues or drafting/re-drafting opens; no checkpoint failures.
acceptance_gate.paging: The complete exact evidence union remains host-side at the fixed path, every demand page is at most 24,000 characters, long-line continuations are executable, first reads in each fresh context are visible, same-context duplicates are bounded, and mounted-union reads do not masquerade as new research.
acceptance_gate.fail_closed: Missing default provider tier, invalid structure, fingerprint drift, packet overflow, or incomparable comparator metadata blocks the claim.

actual_dynamic_fingerprints: Each run config must record exact system-prompt and tool-schema SHA-256 sets plus the combined run fingerprint; these depend on uploaded durable document IDs and are harvested from real context manifests rather than guessed before launch.

preflight.focused_backend_tests: 113 passed across the evidence, wiring, route, and working-set suites after the v3 corrections
preflight.full_backend_tests: 1640 passed, 8 skipped before the v3 corrections; rerun at the final release gate
